const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "Download and pack grill-first plugin tarball",
  command: `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$tmp = 'C:\\Users\\jjq21\\.dsh\\grill-pkg'
if (Test-Path $tmp) { Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $tmp }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $tmp | Out-Null
$zip = Join-Path $tmp 'src.tar.gz'
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://codeload.github.com/InoriMutsumi/dsh-grill-first/tar.gz/refs/heads/main' -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 120
Write-Output ('downloaded ' + (Get-Item $zip).Length + ' bytes')
tar -xzf $zip -C $tmp
Get-ChildItem $tmp | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
$srcDir = Get-ChildItem $tmp -Directory | Where-Object { $_.Name -like 'dsh-grill-first*' } | Select-Object -First 1
Write-Output ('src=' + $srcDir.FullName)
$stage = Join-Path $tmp 'stage'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage | Out-Null
Copy-Item $srcDir.FullName (Join-Path $stage 'package') -Recurse
Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $stage 'package') | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name
Push-Location $stage
tar -czf (Join-Path $tmp 'dsh-grill-first-0.1.1.tgz') package
Pop-Location
Write-Output ('tgz=' + (Get-Item (Join-Path $tmp 'dsh-grill-first-0.1.1.tgz')).FullName + ' size=' + (Get-Item (Join-Path $tmp 'dsh-grill-first-0.1.1.tgz')).Length)
`,
  timeoutMs: 240000,
});
if (r.kind === "foreground") console.log(r.stdout.text.slice(0, 3000), "|ERR|", r.stderr.text.slice(0, 1500));
